For a 3-digit maximum, \(N\le 171\cdot 3=513\). Let \(N=19k\), where \(k=S(N)\). Check descending \(k\le 27\):

- \(19\cdot 27=513\), digit sum \(9\)
- \(19\cdot 26=494\), digit sum \(17\)
- \(19\cdot 25=475\), digit sum \(16\)
- \(19\cdot 24=456\), digit sum \(15\)
- \(19\cdot 23=437\), digit sum \(14\)
- \(19\cdot 22=418\), digit sum \(13\)
- \(19\cdot 21=399\), digit sum \(3+9+9=21\)

Thus \(399=19\cdot 21\).

\boxed{399}
